title: Quick Thai Barbeque Sauce Khanom Thai
description: Tangy, crisp, cozy Thai dish featuring barbeque sauce, sauté, no onion, no garlic, easy to make, Bangkok-style.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable oil and cook for 1 minute.
Add the barbeque sauce and cook until the pork is coated, about 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the Khanom Thai wrappers according to package instructions.
Fill each wrapper with a piece of the pork and a few scallions and cilantro leaves.
Brush the tops of the wrappers with water and fold the bottom half over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a square.
Place the rolls seam-side down in the skillet and cook until browned, about 2 minutes on each side.
Serve hot with additional barbeque sauce and garnishes, if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
Garnish with chopped scallions and cilantro, if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
